title: Badges ruleset
description: Portable, platform-agnostic badge ruleset. Every platform shell integration (macOS FinderSync, Windows shell overlay handler, Linux file-manager extension) reads this same document so behaviour and artwork stay in sync. Badge PNGs live alongside in shared/badges/ (1024px masters, downscaled per platform).

version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

badgingEnabled.description: Master switch. When false the shell draws no badges at all.

fileExtensions.description: Lower-cased extensions without the dot, e.g. ["psd","psb"].

badgeAsset.description: Badge image id. Built-in = base filename in shared/badges/ (e.g. "psd"); custom = filename in the platform's custom-badges container.

isCustomImage.description: True when the image is user-supplied rather than a shipped asset.
